segments.text: This program is hypnotic in nature, and is never to be experienced in a moving vehicle, or other times when you need to maintain awakened consciousness.
For if so many moments slip by unnoticed... doors that open only once, and close so quietly... while others seem to walk through them, so easily... as if the world whispered to them alone...
...then this is your time to sit, or lie back, more comfortably relaxed.

Perhaps reassured by the memory of an old, old story... from the island of Crete, in the long ago... of a king's labyrinth, built to hold a monster... and a princess who held nothing but a simple ball of thread...
And you might even imagine... stepping down those worn stone steps, as twilight settles over the sea... into the torchlit passages, where every turning looks like every other...

Walls of stone, cool beneath the hand... torches sputtering gold along the dark... passage after passage, folding back upon itself... and there, at your feet... a single thread... glinting... unwinding... leading onward through the maze...
For Ariadne's gift was never the thread itself... but the knowing... that there is always a thread...
And as your body naturally breathes more deeply... you may notice the torchlight growing softer... warmer... until the whole labyrinth seems to glow, gently, from within...
Golden threads of light... drifting slowly through the passages... from turning... to turning... from door... to door...
And soon you may sense... these golden threads... falling right upon you... falling right within you... enlightening you... deeply inside...
For as your body naturally breathes more deeply... you can enjoy not having to do anything at all... your inner, wiser self... wandering freely... through the labyrinth... of your own life...
And here... inside your own vast labyrinth... every turning you have ever taken... lies woven... into the path behind you...
Moments from every day... every meeting... every glance... each one a thread... resting... patiently... waiting...
And the golden threads... glinting... everywhere...
A chance remark... threads itself... to a door you had not noticed...
A stranger... to a friendship...
A risk remembered from long ago... to the courage of your own hands...
For no opportunity is ever truly lost... only waiting... for you to notice its thread...
And you might be pleasantly surprised... how many threads appear... when you stop chasing... and simply let them glint...
Like Ariadne... you need only follow each glimmer... wherever it wishes to lead...
And the doors you were born to walk through... stand already open... waiting only for your step...
Each morning... the labyrinth resets its torches... each turning... a new thread glinting...
You need not see the whole maze... only the next golden glimmer...
For fortune is not luck... it is attention... meeting the moment... with a ready hand...
And every thread you follow... teaches your eyes... to find ten more...
The labyrinth of your life... grows brighter... with every thread you take...
And in the stillness between the torches... you may sense the next door... before it even opens...
For you have always been the thread-follower... and the glinting paths... have always been yours...
Your life... one vast and golden labyrinth... every passage within reach... every door within sight...
And soon... new paths opening... like dawn over the labyrinth... fresh chances... seemingly from everywhere at once...
For the whole world is woven... of golden threads... and your eyes... were born... to see them...
And now... as the labyrinth gently brightens... you can bring something back with you...
For what once seemed like luck... was never luck at all... each open door... a golden thread... waiting to be taken...
And each new day, from this day forward... offers its own golden threads... to everything you already are...
And when a glimmer catches your eye... you follow it.
When a door stands open before you... you step through.
And when a door cracks open in your day... you notice.
When a moment asks for your courage... you move.
For you are... the thread-follower... and the whole world... is your labyrinth.
